title: Number of transactions
context: How many rows are in the ledger?
task: Set result to the number of rows in transactions.

title: Transaction columns
task: Set result to the list of column names of transactions.

title: Debits only
task: Set result to the transactions rows where type == 'debit'.

title: Credits only
task: Set result to the transactions rows where type == 'credit'.

title: Net cash flow
context: Sum of all amounts (credits positive, debits negative).
task: Set result to the sum of amount across all transactions, rounded to 2 decimals (blanks ignored).

title: Total income
task: Set result to the sum of amount for credit transactions, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Total spending
context: Debits are negative; report as a positive number.
task: Set result to the total amount spent (absolute value of the sum of debit amounts), rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Transactions per category
task: Set result to a Series of transaction counts per category, sorted descending.

title: Transactions per account
task: Set result to a Series of transaction counts per account_id.

title: Absolute amount
task: Set result to transactions with a column abs_amount = absolute value of amount.

title: Direction label
task: Set result to transactions with a column direction = 'in' if amount > 0 else 'out'.

title: Largest expenses
task: Set result to the 5 transactions with the most negative amount (tx_id, merchant, amount), sorted ascending by amount.

title: Spending per category
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs sum of debit amounts) per category, sorted descending.
hint: filter debit, groupby category, sum, abs.

title: Average transaction per category
task: Set result to a Series of mean amount per category, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by category.

title: Transaction month
task: Set result to transactions with an added column month = 'YYYY-MM' string of date.

title: Transactions in 2025
task: Set result to the number of transactions with date year 2025 (an int).

title: Big transactions
task: Set result to transactions whose absolute amount exceeds 10000.

title: Dining transactions
task: Set result to transactions where category == 'Dining'.

title: Distinct merchants
task: Set result to the number of distinct merchant values in transactions (an int).

title: Most frequent merchant
task: Set result to the merchant (str) with the most transactions.

title: Biggest single credit
task: Set result to the maximum amount among credit transactions, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Missing amounts
task: Set result to the number of transactions with a missing amount (an int).

title: Budget for Groceries
task: Set result to the monthly_budget for category 'Groceries' (an int/number).

title: Total monthly budget
task: Set result to the sum of monthly_budget across budgets (an int).

title: Merchants per category
task: Set result to a Series of merchant counts per category in the merchants table.

title: Account names
task: Set result to the list of account names.

title: Net per account
task: Set result to a Series of the sum of amount per account_id, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Transactions per month
task: Set result to a Series of transaction counts per month ('YYYY-MM'), sorted by month.

title: Credit-card transactions
task: Set result to transactions where account_id == 3.

title: Average spend size
task: Set result to the mean absolute amount of debit transactions, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Uppercase merchant
task: Set result to a Series of the merchant column uppercased.

title: Spend flag
task: Set result to transactions with a column is_spend = True where amount < 0 else False.

title: Transactions per merchant
task: Set result to a Series of transaction counts per merchant, sorted descending, top 10.

title: First transaction date
task: Set result to the earliest date in transactions (a Timestamp).
